post.description:
Queues a background job and returns it at once (202); poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`.

With `feedback`, the planner revises the current roadmap; without it, it makes a fresh plan.
Either way a NEW version is stored when the job completes: earlier versions are kept.

put.description:
Moves a goal along its lifecycle. Asking for the state it is already in changes nothing.

Allowed: active ⇄ paused, active or paused → completed, completed → active (reopen),
any open or completed goal → archived, archived → active (restore).
